runtime_profile_summary: Python 3.11 venv at /opt/benchmark/venv with diffusers installed in editable mode, torch (CPU-only), transformers<5.0.0, peft, and test dependencies
notes: Base image specification fixed: Using python:3.11-slim instead of invalid pytorch/pytorch:2.0.1-cpu tag. Official PyTorch Docker images only offer CUDA variants (no CPU-only tags available), which would be unnecessarily large for CPU-only testing. PyTorch CPU version is now installed via pip from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu index for faster, smaller download. This avoids the invalid image tag error while keeping the image lean.
